commits.message: A press past a row's cells lands on the stop shown beside it; the right-to-left page no longer lists pointer hits as a logical limit; press tests drive one router per input over one render, logical included in the direct press test (review of #567)

Under logical a press reads the column the terminal reports, which is the frame's (VTE's vis2log): drop the router's screen-to-frame mapping, keep TextInput's press on its frame-order stops, and model the terminal's report in the tests (review of #567)

App.frameColumn owns the screen-to-frame column map, cached per painted line; the router asks it once per event; controls stay out of what UAX #9 orders; logical press tests drive the router (review of #567)

Under logical, the router maps a pointer's column through the whole composed line to the frame's (writtenColumn), so a press inside a Panel lands where the terminal shows it; TextInput reads presses off the frame's order and steps off the shown one (rich-control-codes-xh4n.wk5)

A focused Dropdown's filter is the terminal's own cursor (rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr) (#566)

* A focused Dropdown's filter is the terminal's own cursor: where the painter shows it, the caret is a blank cell marked caretMark("bar"), its side set by ordering; labeled takes its label as segments so the mark survives ordering (rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)

* Dropdown: the caret cell survives a header too narrow for its gutter; labeled keeps an empty frame-styled segment unoriented; docs no longer tie the filter's caret shape to TextInput's (review of rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)

* Dropdown: a filter too long for the header shows its tail, so the caret stays at the editing point; docs name Live beside an app (review of rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)

* Dropdown: the query's tail through cellFitEnd, its last glyph before the gutter; docs and module header say a long query shows its end (review of rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)
